caveats: Mwimanzi v. Wilson, U.S. District Court for D.C., filed Jan. 13, 2020 by Mbalaminwe Mwimanzi (represented by ACLU-DC) against MPD Officer Joshua Wilson over a sexually invasive warrantless search on Jan. 15, 2019. March 9, 2022 partial summary judgment held the D.C. all-occupants search law unconstitutional; ACLU case page reports an October 2022 settlement compensating the plaintiff, amount not disclosed in sources. Sources are silent on any criminal proceedings against Wilson, so criminal_status is unknown. WUSA9 fetch timed out and the CourtListener docket returned 403, so exact settlement/termination docket details could not be confirmed.
